description: This file contains helper functions for managing pod containers and converting downward API field labels within the Kubernetes core API, specifically for the 'pods' package.

methods.name: VisitContainersWithPath
methods.description: Iterates over all containers in a pod spec (initContainers, containers, ephemeralContainers) and applies a visitor function to each, short-circuiting if the visitor returns false.

methods.name: ConvertDownwardAPIFieldLabel
methods.description: Converts a downward API field label and value to the internal version, supporting specific labels and handling subscripted paths.
